body: Please sign me up, mostly to discuss #7796 and #7808.

Thanks everyone for attending! Here are the notes from this meeting (the next one is at https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7919):

### Agenda

1. Review past action items
    1. Mason will finish the Chromium testing for [XML MIME types used for documents are not interoperable](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7420) and we'll ask for WebKit feedback.
        1. Joey added the [results](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7420#issuecomment-1115307413) of his testing
        1. Next steps: either align with Chromium/WebKit for shortest path to interop, or Anne to make a proposal and we'll evaluate
    1. Domenic to take a look next at [Valid/Invalid characters in document.createElement()](https://github.com/whatwg/dom/issues/849#issuecomment-1007541209) and Mason/Anne will ask for Chromium/Firefox security opinions.
        1. Some comments added.
        1. Some confusion about Daniel's comments, but generally let's go with Anne's proposal. Next step: Domenic to make a spec.
    1. Domenic to comment and Emilio to test cross-browser behavior on [blur and change events fire for elements removed from DOM](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/3847).
        1. No progress.
    1. Anne is waiting for input from Elika & Tab on the [PR for directionality in the shadow DOM](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/7424).
        1. Currently blocked on Eric to finish the PR.
        1. Anne wants a second reviewer: Olli.
    1. [New feature proposal: Popup API](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7785): Brian to add Emilio to the OpenUI meeting. Olli to get feedback from Mozilla a11y people on their XUL `<popup>` experiences. Mason to summarize the open OpenUI issues in the HTML issue.
        1. Mason [summarized](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7785#issuecomment-1093302321).
    1.  [`<object>` without "data" attribute probably needs to consider params to figure out its URL](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/387): Mason will try to deprecate in Chromium.
        1. Domenic merged a [spec PR](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/7816).
1. Carryovers from last time
    1. [Domenic] [`<object>` element can tell whether child document loaded or not](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7327)
        1. Usage of the fallback is high enough that this will be annoying. Unlikely to work on this in the near future.
    1. [Domenic] [Exposing back/forward cache blocking reasons to sites](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7094)
        1. Olli to raise an issue on the repo explaining that we should probably also talk about eviction reasons, not just prevention-from-going-into-bfcache reasons
    1. [Domenic] [Recommend iframe/img over embed/object for some content types](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/4592)
        1. Domenic to write up a PR
1. New topics
    1. [Emilio] [Inert subtree section is missing requirement that it should NOT be exposed to accessibility](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7796)
        1. Consensus to write down somewhere (Core AAM, HTML?) that inert doesn't go in the accessibility tree.
        1. Also authoring guidance so authors understand the consequences.
    1. [Simon] [Remove UA style for h1-h6 in section (et. al.) and hgroup](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7867)
    1. [Anne] [reportError(), undefined, and ErrorEvent](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7853)
    1. [Emilio] [Define OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D.font setter in detail](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7847)
    1. [Fernando] [Canvas2D Filters](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/5621)
        1. Preference from Mozilla and Apple for not allowing the new CanvasFilter class to be used with ctx.filter, instead that needs to be only usable with a new layer-based API.
        1. Please change the tests to .tentative
    1. [Emilio] [Proposal: extend FocusOptions to allow specifying :focus-visible behavior](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7830)
    1. [Anne] [Rendering of "bitmaprenderer"-backed canvas](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7833)
    1. [Emilio] [inert on an ancestor of modal dialog](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7808)
        1. Consensus to align on Gecko/WebKit behavior. Emilio to send PR, Tim will help review.
        1. Should it also escape pointer-events: none, other things? We need to investigate.
        1. We can use the :modal pseudo-class which CSSWG agreed to add yesterday. Everyone loves UA style rules. This will clean up the inert and `<dialog>` specs.

### Action Items

1. [XML MIME types used for documents are not interoperable](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7420): @annevk to figure out whether Firefox wants to align with Chromium/WebKit, or whether he has a proposed alternative processing model.
1. [Valid/Invalid characters in document.createElement()](https://github.com/whatwg/dom/issues/849#issuecomment-1007541209): @domenic to write a spec PR
1. [PR for directionality in the shadow DOM](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/7424): @meyerweb to finish PR. @smaug---- to review PR in addition to @annevk.
1. [Exposing back/forward cache blocking reasons to sites](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7094): @smaug---- to comment on the repo about eviction, not just preventing-going-into-bfcache.
1. [Recommend iframe/img over embed/object for some content types](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/4592): @domenic to work on a PR to documentation-deprecate these elements as much as possible.
1. [Inert subtree section is missing requirement that it should NOT be exposed to accessibility](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7796): Scott O'Hara seems to be working on authoring guidance. We also need to update Core AAM (?) to state the actual accessibility mapping; unclear who will do that.
1. [Canvas2D Filters](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/5621): @fserb and his team to work on layer proposal, and rename existing tests to .tentative. @domenic and @annevk to discuss whether to revert the PR entirely or keep some of the editorial cleanups or…
1. [inert on an ancestor of modal dialog](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7808): @emilio  to work on spec PR to align on Gecko/WebKit behavior. This might involve using the new :modal pseudo-class and UA style rules, for both `<dialog>` and inert="".

re: 6 - i've created an initial pull request for html aam for inert mappings.  this will be brought up in ARIA's weekly triage of new PRs and we will get feedback/any necessary updates on it.

I will do my best to get some HTML spec text updates regarding some clarifications / author guidance, as soon as possible.
